name: Looking Up to the Earth
source:
A short, bittersweet tale about two souls living on the moon, and how their own shyness kept them apart until the end.

[From [url=https://jonfawkes.itch.io/looking-up-to-the-earth]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一段简短而苦乐交织的故事，讲述生活在月球上的两个人，如何因彼此的羞怯，直到最后也没能走到一起。

[摘自[url=https://jonfawkes.itch.io/looking-up-to-the-earth]Itch.io[/url]]
